translations.text: Where are your fathers? And did the prophets live forever?
Therefore the Lord says this: I will return to Jerusalem with compassion, and my house will be rebuilt, says the Lord Almighty, and a measuring line will again be stretched over Jerusalem.

And the angel who spoke with me said to me: Cry out and say: The Lord Almighty says this: The cities will again overflow with good things, and the Lord will have mercy on Zion and will again take pleasure in Jerusalem.
Ho! Ho! Flee from the land of the north, says the Lord, for I will gather you from the four winds of heaven, says the Lord.
For the Lord Almighty says this: After glory he sent me to the nations that plundered you, for whoever comes near you is like someone who strikes the pupil of his own eye.
And the Lord showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the Lord, and Satan stood at his right hand to oppose him.
The Lord Almighty says this: If you walk in my ways and keep my commands, you will judge my house; and if you guard my courts, I will give you people who walk among those who stand there.
The word of the Lord came to me and said:
And in the third chariot were white horses, and in the fourth chariot were horses of various colors, dappled.
The angel who spoke with me answered and said: These are the four winds of heaven, which go out to stand before the Lord of all the earth.
The word of the Lord came to me and said:

And those among them who are far away will come and build the house of the Lord, and you will know that the Lord Almighty sent me to you. And this will happen if you truly listen to the voice of the Lord your God.
And he sent from Bethel Sharezer and Abusad, kings, and their men to entreat the Lord.
Speak to all the people of this land and to the priests, and say: When you fasted and mourned in the fifth or seventh months for these seventy years, did you really fast for me?
The Lord Almighty says this: Behold, I will save my people from the land of the east and from the land of the west.
For I will bend you, Judah, for myself like a bow, and I will fill it with Ephraim. I will rouse your sons, Zion, against the sons of the Greeks, and I will wield you like a warrior's steel sword.
The sound of shepherds lamenting, for their greatness has been laid waste; the sound of lions roaring, for the heights of the Jordan have been laid waste.

Therefore I will no longer spare the inhabitants of this land, says the Lord. And behold, I will hand over each person into the hands of his neighbor and into the hands of his king. They will strike them, and I will not rescue them from their hands.

And the Lord said to me: Cast that into the furnace, and examine whether it is genuine, as I was found genuine on their behalf. And I took the thirty pieces of silver and cast them into the furnace in the house of the Lord.
And on that day I will make Jerusalem like a stone to be trampled by all the nations. Everyone who tramples on it will mock it with derision, and all the nations of the earth will gather against it.

On that day, says the Lord Almighty, I will strike every horse with panic and its rider with madness. I will open my eyes over the house of Judah, and I will strike all the horses of the nations with blindness.

And the Lord will save the tents of Judah as in the beginning, so that the boasting of the house of David and the pride of the inhabitants of Jerusalem may not exalt themselves over the house of Judah.

And he will gather all the nations against Jerusalem for battle, and the city will be captured, the houses plundered, and the women violated. Half the city will go into captivity, but the remnant of my people will not be destroyed from the city.
And that day will be known to the Lord; it will be neither day nor night, and at evening there will be light.

And if the nation of the Egyptians does not go up and come, then upon them will fall the plagues with which the Lord will strike all the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.
